    50	The 21 pre-existing locale-dependent failures mask real regressions. Fixing them first establishes a trustworthy test suite as a safety net for subsequent code changes. The `IClassFixture<T>` approach is explicit, scoped per test class, and follows xUnit conventions — ensuring the fixture is instantiated once per class and disposed after all tests complete.

The `CurrentCulture_DefaultsToEnglish` replacement test should assert against `CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.Name` (or its parent) when a matching locale file exists, validating the detection contract rather than a hardcoded locale. `LocalizationService.Instance.SetCulture` is thread-safe (uses `lock` internally).
